name: Chesapeake Bay Stewardship Fund
summary: NFWF funds on-the-ground watershed restoration in the Chesapeake Bay region through several competitive programmes. The WILD round funds habitat restoration, conservation and connectivity, with implementation grants and smaller planning and collaboration grants.

amount.note: WILD Implementation grants; planning and collaboration grants are smaller

eligibility.rule: Addresses Pillar 1: Fish and Wildlife Habitat
Does not use funds for ongoing legal-compliance efforts

documents: Letters of support from community partners and/or collaborators
FieldDoc summary PDF, if proposing water quality improvement outcomes
Statement of Litigation, except for government applicants
Board of Trustees or Directors list, or a no-board statement
GAAP audited financial statements, unless current valid information is already on file
IRS Form 990, unless current valid information is already on file
Single Audit, unless current valid information is already on file
Applicant Controls Questionnaire, unless current valid information is already on file

status.quote: Chesapeake Watershed Investments for Landscape Defense (WILD) Grants 2026 Request for Proposals - CLOSED

deadline.quote: Proposal Due Date Thursday, April 9, 2026, 12:00PM (noon) ET

geography.quote: All projects must occur wholly within the Chesapeake Bay watershed.

access.quote: NFWF, in partnership with FWS, is soliciting proposals through the Chesapeake Bay Stewardship Fund (CBSF)

amount.quote: WILD Implementation grants of $75,000 to $500,000 will be awarded for projects that result in direct and measurable on-the-ground actions

co_finance_required.quote: up to 50% of the grant match requirement may be met through federal match from non-Department of Interior sources

eligibility.quote: At a minimum, all proposals must address Pillar 1: Fish and Wildlife Habitat.
All proposed projects must begin on or after September 1, 2026, to facilitate necessary grant contracting and compliance activities.
NFWF funds may not be used to support ongoing efforts to comply with legal requirements, including permit conditions, mitigation and settlement agreements.

after_award.quote: For implementation projects, awardees will be required to report both project-level metrics via Easygrants and more detailed site and practice-level data via FieldDoc

documents.quote: Proposal uses data to support descriptions and submit letters of support from community partners and/or collaborators demonstrating their commitment to the project and engagement in project activities as proposed.
Full Proposal Narrative: The most important upload is your actual full proposal narrative.
For applicants, however, FieldDoc is only required for those proposing water quality improvement outcomes

Statement of Litigation Yes Template provided in Easygrants online application "Uploads" section. Federal, state, and local government applicants are not required to complete this section. Board of Trustees or Directors Yes Provide a list of members. If your organization is not a nonprofit and does not have a Board, upload a document stating that none exists. GAAP Audited Financial Statements* Yes

IRS Form 990* Yes Please refer to the Required Financial Documents and FAQs webpage for details on all financial information required for submission. Single Audit* Yes Please refer to the Required Financial Documents and FAQs webpage for details on all financial information required for submission. Applicant Controls Questionnaire Yes

effort.quote: Proposal Due Date Thursday, April 9, 2026, 12:00PM (noon) ET

co_finance.quote: Implementation projects have a 1:1 non-federal matching contributions requirement.
